text: D2a sample 10 of 10, thetreesnetwork (split: with-residue and composes): a save call, a design proposal, an insider accusation; the labeler instantiates the candidates P06 (tracing a placer) and K04 (an insider's membership claim), restricts P06's friendly-work reading, keeps a personal inscription and a thanks-to-the-host proposal as [new:]; P15 conditioned on what a bare reply approves. Common to the ten: dimensions D01 to D08 as sections, all 51 ids named, every claim cited and every citation in the room's codes, every adapted element named, local_status unresolved and grade with-residue in all ten; the grade sentence names a few of the ledger's elements and often reads as a formula.

D2a defect 1 to handback-D2.md (task template and return specification): the labeler's grade does not vary. All 705 model-D.md files grade composes-with-residue and all 705 say local_status: unresolved. RETURN-D.md asks the labeler not to assert exact fit while evidence remains unresolved and to list each unresolved claim, and every room's record leaves some element unobserved, so composes and validated are out of reach. The cross-table of grade against fleet verdict therefore has one row and cannot inform E1. Not edited mid-return; no labeler re-run.

D2a defect 2 to handback-D2.md (ingest): the ledger's kind field maps every absent line to specification, while SCHEMA section 2 says only observed-absent and not-needed are evidenced and unobserved and not-testable support neither. Of 14,675 absent lines, 67 are evidenced (observed-absent 36, not-needed 31) and 14,608 mark evidence limits (unobserved 7,806, not-testable 6,802); ingest-D.md's kind counts (specification 32,323) overstate evidenced specification by those 14,608 lines. D3 and E1 should split absent lines by observation.

D2a defect 3 to handback-D2.md (ingest and the run record): RUN.json's reissued count is 0 because ingest counts run.json attempts above 1, and every room has attempts 1; the PI's recap says 378 rooms needed one to four same-session repairs of attempt 1. Those repairs, and the rules they fixed, are in no file this stage may read, so the flagged-by-rule count from ingest covers only portability (763 lines). D4's reconciliation should know the repairs exist.

D2a defect 4 to handback-D2.md (the verdict return line, RETURN-D2v): served asks the reader to copy a digest the packet states; 1,409 of 1,410 copied it and one dropped two characters (ducks r1), and 24 of the 32 invalid attempts lacked it; fleet.py's meta records the packet digest apart, so served records copying, not what was served. sub is unreliable: 225 reader lines wrote the room's name otherwise (24 with another name), harmless because ingest takes the room from the folder. The line carries no concept count or pointer count, though contract section 5 says every verdict carries the count; the check here used rooms.jsonl's figures, which each packet stated.

D2a defect 5 to handback-D2.md (task template, minor): [new: ...] is used three ways in the sample: for practices no element covers (most), for conduct that is not organizing (replying to a bot, sympathy in a joke thread), and as a residue tag ('unresolved title-only residue') or for a theme the vocabulary holds (T3-017). The template does not say [new:] is for organizing only. D3 sorts them; nothing edited.

D2a correction to my section 2 line: the story-miss rooms by room verdict are composes-with-residue 14, composes 4, split 1 (19 in all); I wrote 13 from a reading of the printed list, not a count. Checked by script; notes-D2.md carries 14. A slip of the rule never to type a count from memory.

asked QD2-001: D2a: validate.py D2 fails on 8 ledger lines that name a dimension as their element in an op other than link: restrict D02 (4chan-013, SquareSpiral-014), add-condition D02 (borussiadortmund-013), add-condition D01 (cowchop-030, spain-058, torontoraptors-009), restrict D01 (ucf-004), add-step D02 (vermont-011). SCHEMA section 3 allows a dimension id only as the target of link (113 link lines do this and pass). ingest.py's rule 2 (line 186) accepts a dimension for any op, so these 8 rooms were accepted; tools/checks/stage_D2.py line 273 accepts a dimension only for link, so the close-check fails (shape ledger:element). I may not edit a return, re-run ingest or a labeler, or change a tool. Which should hold: the check accepts a dimension for these ops and D3 rules on the 8 lines as they stand, or ingest is tightened and the 8 rooms go back to their labelers? | meanwhile: I change no ledger line, no tool and no return. I finish D2a (notes, handback, head, manifest entry, views) and run done.sh D2 --cut adaptations-in. If the close-check fails only on these 8 ledger:element errors, the leg stays open and I stop; the next packet carries the answer.

D2a closing. Return value: 705 rooms returned and accepted, 0 reissued in RUN.json (378 same-session repairs per the recap, unrecorded in the run), 0 unreturned; 42,243 lines (per room min 21, median 60, p90 68, max 91); ops instantiate 17,648, absent 14,675 (67 evidenced), restrict 4,406, add-step 1,889, add-condition 1,408, propose 1,362, link 844, contradict 11; kinds specification 32,323, correction 4,417, elaboration 4,141, proposal 1,362; flagged by rule: portability 763 (1.81%, 356 rooms); none rooms 0; unplaced source 134 of 27,571 sourced lines (0.5%). Verdicts: readers with-residue 927, composes 432, cannot-tell 49, does-not-compose 2; rooms agreed 542, split 163 (23.1%); cannot-tell coded-share 39, off-platform 10, all supported; labeler grade with-residue in all 705, so the cross-table has one row. Labelers gpt-6.1-sol (resumed with gpt-5.6-sol); readers deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash; both in run_manifest.json's D2 entry. Ten room models sampled by seed 20261016. Written: notes-D2.md (163 split rooms listed), handback-D2.md (six defects), the head (2,981 words, links resolve), the views (gen_views.py D2). validate.py D2: 8 errors, one shape (ledger:element: a dimension as element outside link), asked as QD2-001 (open); 1 warning (ducks r1 served). No .pause. As assumed in QD2-001, I change no ledger line, tool or return and run done.sh D2 --cut adaptations-in; if the close-check fails on these 8 lines only, the leg stays open and I stop. Slips: one count typed from a printed list (13 for 14), corrected and logged; two Edits to the head run as parallel calls (both applied; the head checked intact after).

QD2-001 answered and read (J, option 1, through the PI): the check accepts a dimension as the element of restrict, add-condition and add-step as well as link, and D3 rules on the 8 lines as they stand (stage_D2.py lines 270 to 276, read). What rested on my assumption: I changed no ledger line, no tool and no return, and that stands; the first done.sh attempt failed its close-check on the 8 ledger:element errors alone. To revise: the lines in notes-D2.md, handback-D2.md and the head that call QD2-001 open or the close blocked. Then validate.py D2, the closing line and done.sh D2 --cut adaptations-in.

D2a closing, after QD2-001: J chose option 1 (the check accepts a dimension as the element of restrict, add-condition and add-step; the 8 lines are ruled on as they stand); the handler changed stage_D2.py; I changed no ledger line, tool or return. Revised: notes-D2.md and handback-D2.md (defect 6 answered; ingest still admits a dimension for every op, noted for the operator), the head (QD2-001 carried; 2,995 words, links resolve). validate.py D2: 0 errors, 1 warning (ducks r1 served, reported). The return value is unchanged from the earlier closing line. No .pause. Closing with done.sh D2 --cut adaptations-in; the first attempt failed its close-check on the 8 ledger:element errors alone.
